title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode11 Resolve in Question

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you mean you cut the power?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't tell me you were the ones behind this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's right. It was me.
I was planning to crush you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's your problem?! You go out of your way to invite us just to pull something like this?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I refuse to let anyone without the proper resolve to mouth off about surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And if this little girl here gets tripped up and can't sing after something as small as this, that just proves she doesn't have what it takes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course she'd get thrown off if something like this happened at her very first event! Anybody would!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's not what went through your head in there, is it Shiraishi? The fact that you refused to back down was because you have the resolve.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you're really serious about surpassing that night, I'm willing to bet you refused to let something as trivial as this trip you up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But the shrimp here doesn't feel the same.
That's why she froze up. Am I wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes, you are! Kohane is serious!
She's been practicing like crazy for this event!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you're saying practicing hard is the same thing as having resolve? Don't make me laugh!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're absolutely serious. We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Can you say the same thing, shrimp?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The music world isn't a place you can just come waltzing into like you're on some field trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If this is enough to break you, then you don't belong here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, why didn't you tell them the truth? You didn't—

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Doesn't matter. I'm the reason he did it, and I hate excuses.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But still... Are you really okay with this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come on, Toya. We're up soon. Let's go give 'em a show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to respond...but what do I say...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Shinonome is right...
I thought I'd be all right as long as An was with me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But then I just froze up...
I'm nothing more than a burden on her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Singing with you today was the most exhilarated I've ever felt! I want to try singing more songs with you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len, you seem bored. What ever happened with you going to visit those other two?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've already tried a few times, but they're always either performing in an event or practicing until late at night. It never quite feels like the right time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really hope they come visit soon.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Were you and Rin able to make up?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't tell me you're still fighting.
You two can both be so stubborn sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sh-She's the one who started it.
If she's not going to apologize first, then why should I?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin might be thinking the same thing, you know.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's just saying that you might not see what happened quite the same way. Instead of just assuming the other person is at fault, you should try talking to them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Welcome.
Are you here alone today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane. What's the matter? You look a little down.
